title: Vision Beat Himself With a Question
question: Vision Beat Himself With a Question

sources.title: Head writer Jac Schaeffer on the finale
sources.excerpt: Schaeffer explains why identical Synthezoids needed a logical resolution and distinguishes the restored data from Wanda’s emotional goodbye.

sources.title: GamesRadar / Newsarama on the two Visions
sources.excerpt: The rebuilt original and Wanda’s recreation discuss the Ship of Theseus. The conversation leads to restored memories and White Vision leaving.

sources.title: Marvel on Vision’s goodbye
sources.excerpt: Wanda cannot maintain her fictional world. Her Vision is a memory made real.

claims.text: SWORD rebuilt the original body as White Vision. He fought Wanda’s magically created Vision.
Wanda’s Vision was a magical creation rather than the original physical body.
The fight becomes an identity argument using the Ship of Theseus thought experiment.
Wanda’s Vision unlocks White Vision’s blocked memories. White Vision identifies himself as Vision and flies away.

notes: Marvel Studios’ WandaVision (2021), episode 9. MCU continuity, not a comics event or a recap of later VisionQuest episodes. Recap based on the cited publisher/interview material. Geometric motion is illustrative blocking, not literal footage. The modern character cutouts are illustrative likenesses, not original panels. No continuation or publication is claimed.
